conviction_note: Small positive lean (p_up 56) on a first-as-public-company print with no options and no usable history: headline EPS is likely flattered by a mark-to-market gain on undesignated pay-fixed swaps after a ~75-85bp Q3 rise in rates, and an asset-sensitive balance sheet should see some NIM relief after the 16 Sep Fed hike; both are inference from the company's own disclosed sign history plus macro, the stock already trades at the ~$56 average target and +23% over the $45 IPO, so the scaled number (+0.48) sits below the finding sum (+0.70) because the market and the four covering analysts are expected to strip the swap gain.
bar: Q3 2026 EPS consensus $1.26 (Yahoo, 4 analysts, range $1.17-$1.46, revenue $39.0m) https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/RCBC/analysis/ ; NextEarningsDate ~$1.27 https://www.nextearningsdate.com/rcbc.html ; FXEmpire $1.22 / $38.4m https://www.fxempire.com/stocks/rcbc/earnings. Two sources agree at $1.26-1.27; no company guidance. Q2 2026 actual $1.37 included a $3.2m pre-tax swap MTM gain.
positioning_check: Short interest negligible: ~5.2k shares, ~1.0 days to cover, settlement 2026-08-14, shares out 14.2m (https://stockmarketwatch.com/stock/RCBC); FINRA 2026-06-30 1.4k shares, borrow fee 12.3% (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/rcbc/). No option market, so no skew. Tape: spot $55.20, +8.07% over 20d, +2.49% over 5d, 1.3% below 52w high, ~23% above the $45 IPO price; average sell-side target ~$56 (Raymond James Outperform $56, Stephens EW $54, Davidson Neutral $55, KBW ~$58, initiated 2026-08-31/09-01, https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/rcbc/forecast/). Positioned long into the print with little upside to targets; no crowded short to squeeze.

findings.finding: River City Bank carries interest rate swaps that are partly undesignated (15% at 31 Mar 2026, 17% at 30 Jun 2026) whose MTM flows through noninterest income, and the disclosed sign history shows they gain when rates rise (Q1 2025 -$6.4m and Q2 2025 -$4.0m as rates fell; Q1 2026 +$1.7m, Q2 2026 +$3.2m); Q3 2026 saw the 10-year up ~85bp and the 2-year up ~75bp, so Q3 headline net income likely carries a materially larger swap gain than Q2's $3.2m (each $1m pre-tax is ~$0.05/share on ~14.3m shares), against a $1.26 consensus that typically excludes MTM.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No usable public reaction history: listed 2026-08-06, this is the first print as a Nasdaq company; prior swap swings (Q1 2025 -$6.4m, Q2 2026 +$3.2m) printed while OTC-traded. Management states it does not view the MTM gains/losses as economic, inviting analysts to strip them.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus of $1.26 sits BELOW Q2's $1.37 actual, which is what you would see if analysts model no swap gain; if a large MTM gain were expected the mean would sit above Q2 rather than below it. The high estimate of $1.46 may be the one analyst modelling it.
findings.independence: Rate move from a separate source: WSJ/Dow Jones data via https://stockhub.kr/en/news/news_6701ef10d8c8 (2026-09-30: 10y +85bp, 2y +75bp in Q3). Q2 swap figures from https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260722979484/en/ (2026-07-22). Same company disclosure series; the size of the Q3 gain is inferred, not disclosed, and could be smaller if more swaps were designated as hedges.

findings.finding: RCBC's balance sheet behaved asset-sensitive into falling rates (Q2 2026 NIM 2.34% vs 2.59% a year earlier, earning-asset yield -38bp vs cost of funds -16bp; Q1 2026 NIM 2.38%, asset yields -26bp vs funding -17bp), and the Fed raised the funds range 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on 2026-09-16 with front-end yields up ~75bp in Q3, so Q3 NIM is more likely to stabilise or tick up from 2.34% than to keep compressing.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None public; first print as a listed company.
findings.why_not_priced: Revenue consensus $39.0m (range $37.0-43.6m) is roughly flat-to-Q2, which is what an analyst set assuming no margin inflection would produce; the late-quarter hike only affects ~2 weeks of Q3, so most of the benefit may be a Q4 story and partly visible only in the call on 2026-10-26.
findings.independence: Fed hike: https://www.heygotrade.com/en/market-outlook/bank-stocks-q3-2026-earnings/ (2026-10-15); BofA net interest yield +15bp in Q3 on the same page. Macro-to-company transmission is a proxy; deposit-cost repricing on a 15%-growth deposit base could offset it.

findings.finding: Northern California peer Plumas Bancorp reported Q3 2026 on 2026-10-21: record net income $11.4m, diluted EPS $1.61 vs ~$1.46 consensus, provision down to $150k from $5.4m a year earlier, i.e. no regional credit deterioration showing in the quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: Peer printed after RCBC last spoke (2026-07-22) and after analyst estimates were set; RCBC's +2.5% over 5 days may already hold some of it. Plumas is rural/agricultural, RCBC is Sacramento commercial/CRE, so read-through is weak.

findings.finding: Positioning: the stock at $55.20 is +8.1% over 20 days, 1.3% under its 52-week high and essentially at the $54-58 range of the four initiating targets (average ~$56), ~23% above its $45 IPO price which priced below the $48-51 range; regional bank beat-and-hold prints this season have been sold into (e.g. Simmons -3.8% after a revenue beat).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None for RCBC; season pattern from a peer-group summary.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself: the run-up to target is visible in the sealed tape; filed so the judges see that a beat must clear an already-full valuation relative to targets.
findings.independence: Tape from sealed baseline (run_up_20d 8.07%, pct_from_52w_high -1.32%); season pattern https://www.barchart.com/story/news/837040/winners-and-losers-of-q3-stock-yards-bank-nasdaqsybt-vs-the-rest-of-the-regional-banks-stocks (date not verified from the URL; treat as weak).

outside_window.finding: IPO lock-up on the founder-family selling holders and insiders (2.7m-share 100% secondary priced 2026-08-05) would typically run ~180 days, i.e. around early February 2027.

baseline_tension: The baseline is thin (no options, no history); the positive lean agrees with the +8% run-up rather than cutting against it, which is itself a sign some of it is priced, hence p_up only 56.
lessons_applied: Lesson 2 (one-offs as one-offs): swap MTM gain cut from +0.8 to +0.5 because management itself calls it non-economic and nothing ties it to a guide.
Lesson 5 (macro-to-company proxy is small): NIM inference trimmed from +0.5 to +0.4, filed with independence marked as proxy.
Lesson 8 (thin coverage, first public print): abs_move_pct raised from 3.5 to 4.0; p_up left at 56.
Lesson 6 (bar): checked two agreeing estimate sources ($1.26/$1.27), so no extra cap applied; lock-up placed in outside_window.
